commands.name: sysml

options.description: Suppress progress output on stderr (also silences the progress subscriber even when stderr is a TTY). Place before the subcommand

commands.help:
SysML v2 execution tool

Usage: sysml [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init         Initialize a new SysML project
  info         Show project information
  add          Add a dependency to sysml.toml
  remove       Remove a dependency from sysml.toml
  lock         Resolve dependencies and update sysml.lock
  fetch        Resolve dependencies and fetch/cache all sources (without writing sysml.lock)
  update       Force dependency update and rewrite sysml.lock
  tree         Show dependency graph
  why          Show why a dependency exists in the resolved graph
  cache        Manage local dependency cache
  package      Build a .kpar distribution archive
  eval         Evaluate a SysML expression
  check        Check constraints in a SysML file
  verify       Run a verification case
  analysis     Run an analysis case
  trade-study  Run a trade study (evaluate alternatives against an objective)
  simulate     Simulate a state machine
  run          Run an action
  solve        Solve constraint network via binding propagation
  trace        Generate a sequence trace from flow simulation
  flow         Inspect and test port flows
  project      Manage SysML projects (legacy)
  query        Query elements in a SysML model
  export       Export a SysML model to various formats
  inspect      Inspect semantic tokens and diagnostics for a SysML file
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --quiet    Suppress progress output on stderr (also silences the progress subscriber even when stderr is a TTY). Place before the subcommand
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Inspect semantic tokens and diagnostics for a SysML file

arguments.name: [FILE]
arguments.description: Path to the SysML file (required unless --workspace is used)

options.description: Disable loading the standard library for inspect diagnostics
Override standard library path (directory containing library.kernel/library.systems)
Inspect all files in a workspace directory with cross-file resolution
Focus diagnostics on a specific file within workspace mode
Disable dependency source hydration in workspace mode

commands.help:
Inspect semantic tokens and diagnostics for a SysML file

Usage: sysml inspect [OPTIONS] [FILE]

Arguments:
  [FILE]  Path to the SysML file (required unless --workspace is used)

Options:
      --tokens                       Show only semantic tokens
      --diagnostics                  Show only diagnostics
      --cst                          Show raw CST (tree-sitter parse tree)
      --json                         Output as JSON
      --no-stdlib                    Disable loading the standard library for inspect diagnostics
      --library-path <LIBRARY_PATH>  Override standard library path (directory containing library.kernel/library.systems)
      --workspace <WORKSPACE>        Inspect all files in a workspace directory with cross-file resolution
      --focus <FOCUS>                Focus diagnostics on a specific file within workspace mode
      --no-workspace-deps            Disable dependency source hydration in workspace mode
  -h, --help                         Print help
